words.exampleSentence: 美丽的蝴蝶在花丛中翩翩起舞。
words.exampleTranslation: The beautiful butterfly dances gracefully among the flowers.
words.funFact: The 'Butterfly Lovers' (梁祝) is one of China's Four Great Folktales, renowned for its romance.

words.exampleSentence: 夜空中闪烁着无数颗星星。
words.exampleTranslation: Countless stars twinkle in the night sky.

words.exampleSentence: 出门记得带雨伞，今天可能会下雨。
words.exampleTranslation: Remember to take an umbrella when going out, it might rain today.

words.exampleSentence: 清晨的太阳冉冉升起，温暖大地。
words.exampleTranslation: The morning sun rises slowly, warming the earth.

words.exampleSentence: 山上有一座古老而壮观的城堡。
words.exampleTranslation: On the mountain stands an ancient and magnificent castle.

words.exampleSentence: 坚持你的梦想，努力就会有收获。
words.exampleTranslation: Hold on to your dream; hard work will yield rewards.

words.exampleSentence: 向日葵总是朝着阳光生长的方向。
words.exampleTranslation: Sunflowers always grow facing the direction of the sunlight.

words.exampleSentence: 大雨过后，天边出现了一道美丽的彩虹。
words.exampleTranslation: After the heavy rain, a beautiful rainbow appeared on the horizon.

words.exampleSentence: 只要心中有希望，就没有克服不了的困难。
words.exampleTranslation: As long as there is hope in our hearts, there are no obstacles we cannot overcome.
words.etymology: Compound of 希 (rare/hope) + 望 (look forward to/hope)

words.exampleSentence: 加油！你一定能学好这门新语言！
words.exampleTranslation: Keep it up! You will definitely master this new language!
words.funFact: 'Jiayou' is one of the most widely recognized Chinese encouraging phrases and is officially recognized in the Oxford English Dictionary.
